units.source_text: 七点过后，我说了声“我出去玩一会儿就回来”，便飞跑出去了。

en.t: After seven o'clock, I said, "I'm going out to play for a little while and will be back soon," and then dashed outside.

units.source_text: 约莫十点钟，回到家门口就听见了祖父那难受的呼喊声：“阿常，阿常！”

en.t: Around ten o'clock, when I got back to the entrance of the house, I heard my grandfather's pained cry: "O-Tsune, O-Tsune!"
